status: test-local toy finite-field parity and matched-shape body projections; no trained decoder or independent deployment

execution_reference.scalar_operator: x^2 + 3x + 7 modulo 65521, calculated only by the trusted client at each rank-width cut
execution_reference.public_weights: bounded signed coefficients [-2, 2]; one independently held activation/state share per worker
execution_reference.toy_workload: 3 prompt rows plus 2 teacher-selected feedback rows; 3 layers, hidden width 8, rank 4, 8 output codes
execution_reference.session_and_frame_binding: unique session digest, party, monotonically increasing token position and layer, bounded tensor length; replay or malformed field residue erases that worker's state

hypothetical_24_layer_896_wide_costs.scope: public-weight 64-code model that does not exist; only reference frame/header algebra is implemented for two-byte field words; four/eight-byte words require new exact numeric and transport contracts

decision: No rank16/32 Qwen retrofit: 24 optimistic rank32 output projections matched 3/12 prefill and 1/12 same-token decode selections; the separately fitted affine-residual oracle reaches 3/12 and 0/12 at 24 cuts. Neither found a retrospective margin witness. Do not promote the toy field or body projections as a decoder or 100x network result. A jointly trained, exact-numeric low-rank architecture must first pass real-text quality, full-response transport, cold CPU and all-link/disk budgets.
limitations: The toy output vocabulary has 8 codes and the hypothetical model allows at most 64; there is no trained replacement for Qwen's 151936-way output head.
The field quadratic has no fixed-point parity with Qwen; using 4/8-byte words changes the numeric contract and is not implemented.
Bodies include typed frame headers but exclude HTTP/TLS, independent-host traffic, setup and public checkpoint distribution.
The in-process workers do not authenticate transport or demonstrate operator independence; the client is trusted with cut activations.

The recurrence has a secret-dependent nonlinear cut at every layer and token; prefill cannot simply batch all tokens per layer. The wavefront figure is a scheduling lower bound, not an implemented path.
Integer MAC count is not a CPU time, memory, generation-quality or matched-compute measurement.
